python.name: test_public_batch_rejects_bad_export_even_with_valid_console
parameters: pytest.mark.parametrize('export,reason', [(None, 'export channel missing'), (EXPORT[:-1], 'unterminated'), (b'kernel text must not enter the export\n' + EXPORT, 'unexpected export record'), (EXPORT.replace(b'1000', b'not-an-integer'), 'invalid guest batch protocol'), (EXPORT.replace(b'LO_QUALIFICATION_COMPLETE:1\n', b''), 'completion missing')])

python.name: test_http_producer_uses_one_service_and_checks_stopped
parameters: pytest.mark.parametrize('stopped_event,valid', [({'command': 'serve', 'status': 'stopped'}, True), ({'command': 'run', 'status': 'stopped'}, False), ({'status': 'stopped'}, False), ({'command': 'serve', 'status': 'ready'}, False), ({'command': 'serve'}, False), ([], False)])

python.name: test_public_cli_rejects_obfuscated_untracked_dependencies
parameters:
pytest.mark.parametrize('directive', [b'#\
include "extra.h"
', b'#inc\
lude "extra.h"
', b'/* prefix */#include "extra.h"
', b'#/**/include "extra.h"
', b'# /* gap */ include "extra.h"
', b'%:include "extra.h"
', b'%\ 
:include "extra.h"
', b'%\	
:include "extra.h"
', b'??=include "extra.h"
', b'#pragma clang module import extra
', b'_Pragma("clang module import extra")
'])
